name: The Falsifier's Ledger
ins: The falsifier writes that waiting stills the blades; the ledger answers that every step turns the beat, and no waiting turns it back.
hint: Each move flips your beat, and pacing out and back flips it twice, so the beat you land on never changes no matter how you loiter. Blades only sleep on even beats, so read which stones can ever be safe before you commit, and recall the crumbling slab forgives no second visit.
